name: Default
shortDescription: Open source password manager for teams with GPG-based end-to-end encryption, backed by MariaDB with persistent server keys.

alerts.message: There is no sign-up page. Create the first administrator from a terminal in the passbolt container with: su -m -c "/usr/share/php/passbolt/bin/cake passbolt register_user -u you@example.com -f First -l Last -r admin" -s /bin/sh www-data, then open the setup link it prints. The Passbolt browser extension is required to finish setup.
User invitations and account recovery are sent by email. Configure an SMTP server in Organisation settings > Email server after the first login.
